entries.title: Psalms 28:1
segments: A Psalm of David. I will cry to You, O LORD; my Rock, do not be deaf to me, lest, [if] You be silent to me, I become like those who go down into the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 28:2
segments: Hear the voice of my prayers, when I cry to You, when I lift up my hands toward Your Holy Place.

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
segments: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors, yet evil [is] in their hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 28:4
segments: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their practices, give them according to the work of their hands; give them what they deserve.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
segments: Because they do not pay attention to the works of the LORD and to the work of His hands, He shall destroy them and never build them up.

entries.title: Psalms 28:6
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD, because He has heard the voice of my prayers.

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in Him, and I am helped; therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song I will praise Him.

entries.title: Psalms 28:8
segments: The LORD [is] a strength to them, and He [is] the saving strength of His anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 28:9
segments: Save Your people, and bless Your inheritance; feed them also, and lift them up forever.
